posts.author: static_remains
posts.body:
I realize not everyone is aware of possible alternatives, so I'll do my best to compile whatever seems useful here if someone stumbles across it, feel free to add anything I miss (personally, I'm dodging the official "RPG Maker Guild"):
Communities:
1. RPG Refuge / RMW Refugees
Official website:
https://rpg-refuge.com/
Official thread:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/thre...n-while-we-figure-out-what-to-do-next.183988/
started by @/TheAM-Dol
Discord:
https://discord.gg/Fg4b5gxGUw
2. RPGMaker.net / RMN
(preexisting forum!)
Official website:
https://rpgmaker.net/
Discord:
https://discord.gg/9crGAp5
3. Save-Point.org / Save Point
(another forum!)
Official website:
https://save-point.org/
Discord:
https://discord.gg/e6GuF54T32
4. RMPLANET
**edit: I saw
https://forum.rmplanet.com/
mentioned as well, im on mobile rn so this is a rushed add-on sorry
Resources / Archive:
1. RPG Maker Chat
(potential forum?? not sure if I'm misreading it)
Official website:
https://rpgmakerchat.com/
They're focused on archiving the entire forum, 11.4% done at the time of me posting this
2. Internet Archive / Wayback Machine
Official website:
https://web.archive.org/
More specific for this forum:
https://web.archive.org/web/20260000000000*/forums.rpgmakerweb.com
3. Check if game devs you follow have itch.io or websites / discords
This is more generic, but just because the forum is going down doesn't mean everything is.
If there's someone you want to support or a plugin developer you don't want to lose access to, check their profiles + maybe there's a community discord somewhere!
(I'll update here if I find some b4 shutdown)
4. Reddit ???? Youtube ?????
r/RPGMaker Website:
https://www.reddit.com/r/RPGMaker/
Similar logic, there are communities on Reddit + if there's an RPGmaker youtuber, then they might have a discord that's worth joining
seriously, that's all I've got for now but please message below if I missed anything, I'll post this in a different category as well so we can have a bit of hope.
let's meet again somewhere on the other side!

posts.body:
The last time I used Save-Point I got into an argument with the administrator about how trans rights were being threatened by Trump (ie. he was insistent it wasn't) and a short skim shows he was posting anti-climate-change rhetoric a couple of years ago.
If that forum wants to show its improved its political bend I invite it to, but I'm not comfortable about going back.
... also
allowing AI generated content
isn't a good look.

I can’t personally vouch for anything besides the very solid community effort being made at RPG Refuge right now, Point Save was added to the list because I saw a member here say they were actively archiving threads from this forum on there
Frustration is understandable with bad experiences but I’m trying to bookmark wherever archiving or community migration is happening for future reference, primarily since posting will not be possible soon-
If anyone seeing this has somewhere they heard about that wasn’t on the list, please reply below before the final bell tolls..!
